title: Concept: Authorisation state carried in a hidden field
description: A hidden input that carries a role, tenant or admin flag in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The client echoes the field back, so a user who edits it can present a privilege the server never granted unless every handler re-derives it from the session.
applicability: Deployments that render a hidden input that carries a role, tenant or admin flag into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The client echoes the field back, so a user who edits it can present a privilege the server never granted unless every handler re-derives it from the session.
